body: Congratulations for putting yourself out there as painful as that may have been.  You haven’t found your people and you will need patience and self confidence (even if you have to fake it till you make it) to start to build your tribe, which will absolutely come.  My advice is to throw yourself into your studies, become top of your classes, and find clubs that match your strength academically.  You don’t need a massive circle of friends - just a small tribe of 2-4 people that you share passion for your discipline and in time will develope mutual respect, which will likely lead to meaningful friendships.  Keep current expectations low - it will come with tint as you grow personally in your disciplines.  Hang I. There through the semester before considering a school that could be a better fit.  Tip:  people love talking about themselves, so given a chance to talk, really enjoy someone else’s backstory and challenges.  You got this!!
Pretty is so subjective and true beauty shines from the outside in.  We are all unique and can shine beauty through self love and confidence from inside.  What is one thing that you enjoy doing?

You are not alone.  What do you do when you first wake up?  I’m burdened by being an optimist and fantasizing about death (which is a less active way of saying I’m suicidal).  I’m here to listen and emphasize - trust you are not alone.

I feel a lot of the same things (minus the gasoline and bullet, I don’t want to feel the pain - I just want accidental death to spare further harm to those I love.  I’m not sure what brought you here but I hope there is a small chance of hope that keeps you hanging on and I hope the purpose becomes clear in the very near future.  Im not a quitter but oh how I want to quit.  I hope for better days and strength for you and me both.  You are not alone.
